While the source uses a deb package from a third-party release, this does not pose a risk during `--printsrcinfo`, as no download or extraction occurs at this stage. The use of `::` in the source array to rename the file is standard practice.

No obfuscated code, network calls, or data exfiltration attempts occur during the sourcing phase. All content aligns with normal AUR packaging conventions.
